description: Shared project settings. The dispatch approval gate that used to live here as a PreToolUse hook was REMOVED on 2026-08-27, by the user's decision. cursor-agent reads this file and applies its PreToolUse hooks to its own shell tool: on Windows it wraps the command in PowerShell and then executes the result under bash, which rejects `& {`, so every shell command in the composer and grok lanes died before starting. The hook was written to gate Claude Code's Bash and PowerShell tools and had no business governing cursor-agent. See .claude/skills/dispatch/HOOK-DESIGN.md for what it did, and the dispatch SKILL.md for the rule it enforced -- that rule still stands on its own: the wrapper is the only way in, whether or not anything enforces it.
